jobs.title: African Diaspora Studies Two-Year Mellon Postdoctoral Fellowship (Start Fall 2026)
jobs.description: The Department African Diaspora Studies invites applications for a two-year Andrew W. Mellon Postdoctoral Fellowship beginning Fall 2026. Eligible candidates must have received their terminal degree no earlier in 2023 or later. We seek interdisciplinary/transdisciplinary scholars whose work centers the experiences, histories, ideas, and creativity of people of African descent across the globe. Candidates must hold a terminal degree with significant coursework in Critical Black Studies/Africana Studies. Applicants should demonstrate significant promise in teaching, research, and contributions to community, as well as a strong commitment to theorizing from and/or centering Africana, Black, and African-descended perspectives. The annual teaching load for the Fellow is two courses per year (one per semester). The Fellow also will be expected to share their research with the Grinnell community and to be a contributing member of the African Diaspora Studies Department faculty.   Additional information about our curriculum and faculty can be found at the Department’s website. https://www.grinnell.edu/academics/majors-concentrations/african-diaspora-studies

jobs.title: Assistant Professor for Management and Entrepreneurship
jobs.description: Position Title:Assistant Professor for Management and EntrepreneurshipAppointment Type:FacultyJob Description:Summary of Duties and Responsibilities:The Department of Management and Entrepreneurship in the Ivy College of Business at Iowa State University invites applications for a tenure-eligible Assistant Professor position in the fields of Organizational Behavior (OB)/Human Resources (HR) or Entrepreneurship, to begin August 2027. The selected candidate will be expected to publish high-impact research in top-tier Management and/or Entrepreneurship journals. New hires typically teach an undergraduate course in their respective field (OB/HR or Entrepreneurship) in their first years (usually a single prep) and can later teach courses in the MBA or PhD programs. This full-time faculty position is on campus and in person.Required Minimum Qualifications:PhD in Management, Organizational Behavior, Human Resources, Entrepreneurship, or related field prior to starting the position.Demonstrated ability to produce strong scholarly research.Demonstrated ability to teach undergraduates.Must meet the college’s standards to be Scholarly Academic Qualified under AACSB Accreditation standards.Preferred Qualifications:A record of publications in high-quality journals and papers presented at major conferences.Significant research in progress targeted at top Management or Entrepreneurship journals.A record of high-quality teaching in the areas of Organizational Behavior/Human Resources or Entrepreneurship.Evidence of engagement with and service to the profession and field.Department/Program & College Description:The Department of Management and Entrepreneurship is a supportive and productive group of 40+ faculty members (20 tenure-track and 22 term), currently chaired by Chad Murphy. With research interests spanning the areas of OB, HR, Entrepreneurship, Strategy, and Healthcare Management, our faculty have published research in a wide variety of top journals, including the Academy of Management Journal, Academy of Management Review, Strategic Management Journal, Organization Science, Journal of Management, Journal of Applied Psychology, Journal of Business Venturing, Entrepreneurship Theory and Practice, and Strategic Entrepreneurship Journal. The department offers undergraduate degrees in Management, Entrepreneurship, Human Resource Management, and Healthcare Management. The department also offers a Masters in Entrepreneurship and PhD programs in Management as well as Entrepreneurship.The Ivy College of Business was established in 1984. It conducts and shares research to educate tomorrow’s business leaders so they are prepared to overcome multi-disciplinary global, technological, and ethical challenges. The college is accredited by The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB International). It enrolls over 5,000 students and offers numerous degree programs, including an MBA program, which is ranked #16 in the country among public universities, and an entrepreneurship undergraduate program ranked #9 in the nation. Tied to the Ivy College of Business is the Pappajohn Center for Entrepreneurship, which serves the ISU campus with educational workshops, experiential learning, student business venture incubation, and ongoing venture support, as well as the Small Business Development Center, which offers startup assistance to students, faculty, and the community. The center has earned prestigious national and international recognition, including the Global Consortium of Entrepreneurship Centers’ Exceptional Contributions in Entrepreneurship Research (2024), the NASDAQ Center for Entrepreneurial Excellence Award (2022), the Accreditation Council for Entrepreneurial and Engaged Universities’ Entrepreneurial University of the Year (Americas) (2023), and the United States Association for Small Business and Entrepreneurship’s Model Program Award (2021). The larger entrepreneurial ecosystem at Iowa State University, under the Vice President for Economic Development & Industry Relations, includes a 500+ acre Research Park that houses more than 100 companies, a year-long startup accelerator, and a top-tier technology transfer research foundation.Department Unit/Website:https://www.ivybusiness.iastate.edu/about-ivy/academic-departments/management-and-entrepreneurship/Proposed Start Date:August 16, 2027Number of Months Employed Per Year:09 Month Work PeriodTime Type:Full timeApplication Instructions:To apply for this position, please click on “Apply” and complete the Employment Application. jobs.title: Assistant Professor of Art Two-Year Mellon Postdoctoral Fellowship (Start Fall 2026)
jobs.description: The Department of Art invites applications for a two-year Andrew W. Mellon Postdoctoral Fellowship in Video production and Digital Media Fall 2026. Eligible candidates must have received their terminal PhD or MFA degree in 2023 or later.   The annual teaching load for the Mellon Fellow is two courses per year (one per semester). The Mellon Fellow will support both the Art Studio Major and the Film and Media Studies (FMS) concentration by teaching two FMS/ART video production courses in AY26–27 and two ART digital media studio courses in AY27–28. The FMS-255 Fundamentals of Video Production course is a FMS Concentration requirement, and will connect with a wide range of Majors/Concentrations across campus. The ART-246 level Digital Media course is an elective Studio Art major course that helps to fulfil the major's requirements. The Fellow will also be expected to share their research with the Grinnell community and to be a contributing member of the department.   Additional information about our curriculum and faculty can be found at Film and Media Studies Concentration: https://www.grinnell.edu/academics/majors concentrations/film - media and Studio Art Major: https://www.grinnell.edu/academics/majors concentrations/studio - art

jobs.title: Assistant Professor of German Studies One-Year Term (Start Fall 2026)
jobs.description: The Department of German Studies invites applications for a 1-year term appointment with the possibility of renewal in any area of German Studies, beginning Fall 2026. Near-native fluency in German is required. Assistant Professor (Ph.D.) preferred; Instructor (ABD) or Associate Professor possible. Research and teaching interests might include but are not limited to: 20 th -21 st century German-language literature, film, visual culture, theater, or other media; interdisciplinary connections to African Diaspora Studies, Jewish Studies, Gender and Women’s studies, LGBTQ+ studies, (post)colonial studies, or a focus on other minoritized communities in the German-speaking world. The teaching load is five courses over two semesters.  Additional information about our curriculum and faculty can be found at HTTPS://WWW.GRINNELL.EDU/ACADEMICS/MAJORS-CONCENTRATIONS/GERMAN.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor of Mathematics Two-Year Term (Start Fall 2026)
jobs.description: The Department of Mathematics invites applications for one or more position of up to 2-years appointment with the possibility of renewal beginning Fall 2026. Assistant Professor (Ph.D.) preferred; Instructor (ABD) or Associate Professor possible. Research and teaching interests can be in any area of mathematics.  The teaching load is five courses over two semesters.   Additional information about our curriculum and faculty can be found at https://www.grinnell.edu/academics/majors-concentrations/math.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor of Neuroscience 2-Year Term (Start Fall 2026)
jobs.description: GRINNELL COLLEGE. The Neuroscience Program invites applications for a neuroscientist with a 2-year term contract, beginning Fall 2026. Assistant Professor (Ph.D.) preferred; Instructor (ABD) or Associate Professor possible. The teaching load of five courses over two semesters (with lab sections counting as ½ course) will include one or more courses in our neuroscience curriculum (Foundations of Neuroscience and/or Neuroscience Senior Seminar), with the remaining courses in either the biology or psychology departments, depending on the candidates’ interest/expertise . Term contract renewals are subject to departmental and college priorities and budget availability.   Additional information about our curriculum and faculty in Biology, Psychology and Neuroscience can be found at https://www.grinnell.edu/academics/majors-concentrations/   Complete applications, which include letters of recommendation, will be considered on a rolling basis. Regarding recommendation letters, note that once the applicant submits their portion of the application, the system will email requests for letters to reference providers indicated by the applicant in the application. The applicant will be able to track the submission status of these reference letters online.

jobs.title: Clinical Associate/Assistant Professor Social Work
jobs.description: Faculty HomeMy Faculty JobsSearch Jobs CLINICAL ASSOCIATE/ASSISTANT PROFESSOR SOCIAL WORKRequisition # 75950Position BasicsType of PositionCLINICAL-TRACKAdvertising Ends on:Extended Until Position is FilledAdvertising Started on:Thursday, May 28th, 2026College:College of Liberal Arts & SciencesDepartment:Social WorkSalarySalary:CommensuratePosition DetailsFull/Part Time Status:Full TimePosition Description:CLINICAL ASSISTANT/ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR (Iowa City MSW Practicum Faculty) School of Social Work Iowa City, IA ANTICIPATED START DATE: AUGUST 1, 2026 (FLEXIBLE) The University of Iowa, School of Social Work seeks a full-time, 12-month, clinical assistant or associate professor to support student success when preparing for, entering, and completing social work practicum at the master’s level. This position involves teaching practicum content courses, assisting with training practicum students and supervisors, identification and development of new placement sites based on the needs of the program and students, and serving as the lead liaison to practicum sites. The individual should have social work practice experience and expertise to guide MSW students specializing in clinical or leadership practice in seeking practicum placements. The individual should also have experience teaching in social work, with the ability to teach in person and online. They should also be able to engage in professional productivity and service. This position is based in Iowa City. The initial appointment is for one year (2026-27), renewable for up to two years (2027-28) and 2028-29), and renewable thereafter in three-year increments, pending collegiate approval and demonstrated excellence in teaching. More information about the Clinical Track can be found on the Provost’s website at https://provost.uiowa.edu/human-resources-administration/faculty-hr-administration/faculty-appointment#clinical. The School of Social Work offers programs at the BA, MSW, and PhD levels with faculty scholarship foci in the areas of aging, child welfare, behavioral and mental health, and organizations and communities. In addition to programs on our main Iowa City campus, the School of Social Work maintains MSW programs in Des Moines, Sioux City, and an online program serving all of Iowa and surrounding states. For more information on the School’s many resources and programs, see our homepage at http://socialwork.uiowa.edu. (Requisition #75950) Applicants are strongly encouraged to submit their materials immediately, as application review will begin June 1, 2026. All materials must be submitted online at https://jobs.uiowa.edu/jobSearch/faculty/ . Refer to requisition number #75950. Do not mail paper applications. A curriculum vitae, letter of application describing your interest, preparation, and vision for social work practicum education and contact information for three references will need to be attached during the online application process. For inquiries about the position please contact the Search Committee Chair: Peggy L. Trosper, MSW, LMSW, Director of Practicum Education University of Iowa School of Social Work 308 North Hall, Iowa City, IA 52242 peggy-trosper@uiowa.edu WORK AUTHORIZATION INFORMATION For H-1B petitions subject to the September 19, 2025 Presidential Proclamation, please note that the department will not cover the $100,000 payment associated with H-1B sponsorship, either at the time of hire or for international travel purposes. We encourage impacted individuals to explore alternative pathways for work authorization. Our team is available to help identify options that may be suitable for your situation. MISCONDUCT DISCLOSURE Successful candidates will be required to self-disclose any misconduct history or pending research misconduct investigation including but not limited to sexual misconduct in prior employment and provide a related release and will be subject to a criminal background and credential check. Education Requirement: MSW from a CSWE accredited program. Required Qualifications: A minimum of three years post-graduate level practice experience. Demonstrated teaching experience in social work. Experience with practicum education (as practicum supervisor, liaison, or practicum seminar instructor) Current license at the Master’s level of social work (LMSW). Potential for professional productivity, practice, and service through such activities as CEU or conference presentations, professional consultation, outreach activities, publications, membership in state or regional boards or professional organizations. Desirable Qualifications: Knowledge of Council on Social Work Education (CSWE) Educational Policy and Academic Standards. LISW or equivalent clinical social work licensure in current state of residence/employment. Five or more years post-graduate level practice experience in clinical or leadership practice. Online Application Required Documents Curriculum VitaeLetter of InterestSupporting Attachments Number of References: 3 Letters of Recommendation are required as part of the application process. jobs.description: Ashley Price, BSN, RN, PMH-BC, thought she was heading home for good after nursing school.
